:::{#exr-bernoulli-loglik-contribution}
#### Log-likelihood contribution of one binary outcome

Let:

- $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$, with no [covariates](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate);
- $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$ be the observed value of $\Outvar_\iobs$.

Derive the [log-likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-loglik) contribution $\llik_\iobs(\prob)$ of observation $\iobs$,
the [log](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-loglik) of its [likelihood component](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-lik-factor).

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-loglik-contribution}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\llik_\iobs(\prob)
&= \logf{\Pr(\Outvar_\iobs = \outvar_\iobs)}
&& \text{(log of the likelihood component)}\\
&= \logf{\prob^{\outvar_\iobs} (1 - \prob)^{1 - \outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{(Bernoulli PMF)}\\
&= \logf{\prob^{\outvar_\iobs}} + \logf{(1 - \prob)^{1 - \outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{(log of a product)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs \logf{\prob} + (1 - \outvar_\iobs) \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(log of a power)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
